title: Professor of Law
bio: Richard M. Re is a Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. His primary research and teaching interests are in constitutional law, federal courts, and criminal procedure. He was professor of the year when teaching at UCLA in 2017, gave the charge to the class of 2024 while at UVA, and received the Charles Fried […]
